title: Abstract Harmonic Analysis

syllabus.details: Topological groups and their properties,Subgroups, Quotient groups.
Haar measure (without proof), properties Computation of Haar measures for classical groups.
Convolution, Group algebra and its properties.
Approximate identities, Examples for the real line R, and the unit circle T.
The representations of Group and Group algebras.
GNS constructions, C*-algebra of a group.
Dual group of abelian groups, Fourier transform.
Fourier inversion formula, Plancherel theorem for Abelian groups.
Irreducible representations of compact non-abelian groups.
